title: Articles of Association
question: What are the Articles of Association?

body.normal: The Articles of Association are the company's internal rulebook: how directors are appointed, how meetings are held, how shares are issued and transferred, and how decisions are made.
body.simple: The AOA are the rules for how the company is run.
body.detail: The AOA is filed with the MOA at incorporation. It sets out the rights of shareholders, the powers of the board, how meetings are called and how shares move. A private company's articles restrict share transfers. They can be changed later by a special resolution of the shareholders.
body.why: When a question comes up about who can decide something in the company, the articles are where the answer is.
